max_bytes.description: maximum delivered size in bytes (default 10 MB, matching the ACP client cap)

n.description: cited page number (PDF), as shown in `[#n]` — used for provenance and, if the file exceeds the cap, to deliver just that page

path.description: document path, exactly as shown in a search/grep result

raw.description: return the untouched original file instead of the default PDF conversion (currently only affects DOCX, delivered as PDF by default); default false
